devdoc.details: Permissions reset by the root epoch; invested positions remain external module claims. External approvals outside this contract and untracked donated assets are not certified.

quarantine(address,bytes32).notice: Explicitly isolate an unreadable token. Its unresolved claim stays in every snapshot. Quarantine never clears approvals or proves solvency. Adapter input/output is disabled; the controller retains withdraw-to-root recovery if the token allows transfers.

retire(address).notice: Frees a tracking slot only for a readable zero balance; history remains committed.

userdoc.notice: Separate account, separate funded balance, no root execution or delegatecall.
